note: Roosevelt County publishes no zoning district layer; its GIS page lists none. Portales, the county's largest city and seat, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (portalesnm.gov Planning & Zoning page). The only queryable zoning layer found, Clovis Zoning on gisportal.cityofclovis.com, covers Clovis in Curry County, not Roosevelt County. ArcGIS search returned only fire-district layers for Roosevelt County.
